post.description: Initiates an OIDC SSO login flow for the specified domain. You can optionally include uiRedirectHost in the request body to override the redirect URI for the authorization request and token exchange. Only loopback addresses (localhost or 127.0.0.1) are accepted. Use host or host:port format without a protocol or path (for example, localhost:4200). The value must exactly match an entry in AllowedSsoRedirectHosts, including the port when configured; an empty list disables this override. When set and allowed, the API uses http://host:port/sso-complete as the redirect URI. Register that URI in your identity provider before you start the flow.
